sections_referred: Order 22 Rule 3 of Civil Procedure Code, 1908
advocates: For Respondent(s): Mr. N. Manokaran for R 2
prayer: Prayer: Petition filed under Order 22 Rule 3 of Civil Procedure Code to bring on record the petitioners 1 to 3 as legal representatives of the deceased Appellant/Dhanaraj in the second appeal
judgment_text:
ORDER

This Petition has been filed to bring the petitioners 1 to 3, as legal heirs of the deceased-appellant.

2. The learned counsel for the 2nd respondent has no objection to allow the present petition.

3. Considering the reasons stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition and taking note of the fact that the petitioners are the legal heirs of the deceased appellant and that they are proper and necessary parties to the appeal, the present petition is allowed.

Registry is directed to Post the matter on 19-2-2026 after carrying out necessary amendment.
